newsitem.title: USA: U.S. urges citizens to avoid Ecuador protests.
newsitem.headline: U.S. urges citizens to avoid Ecuador protests.

text.p: The United States on Friday urged its citizens to steer clear of demonstrations planned in Ecuador next Wednesday, saying violence was likely.
Trade unions in Ecuador have called a general strike for Feb. 5 in reaction to economic cutbacks by the government.

"While there have been no reports that foreign entities are a target of the protests, violence is likely and could pose a threat to the general public, including American citizens," the State Department said.

"The (U.S.) embassy advises all Americans to exercise caution and to avoid those areas of Quito and other cities where demonstrations are likely to occur," the department said in a public announcement.
